articles.title: How a Rate Cap Would Shrink Credit-Card Rewards

articles.summary: Barrons.com: How a Rate Cap Would Shrink Credit-Card Rewards. President Trump’s proposed 10% cap on interest rates would force issuers to be more selective with their reward programs. That would hit users with lower credit scores. Related tickers mentioned: AXP, BFH, SYF, SYF-PB.
